methodology.prior_source: recorded corpus over the same window and mode (segment-independent); 0.5 when the corpus window is below segment_min_decided

notes: These are the population's decks and levels; nothing here checks what any one player holds. Before naming a row as a recommendation to a person, pass fit_for with their tag: rows they cannot field leave decks[], and every row then says what they would field it at and what upgrades would open.
excluded counts the season and mode, not the band (a duel or a boat battle has no band); decided_battles and every row are the band's.
Pooled player-battle observations, not unique matches: both participants can contribute, so counts are dependent.
Only decided head-to-head battles count; `excluded` says how many duels, boat battles, draws and unresolved outcomes the window held.
shrunk_win_rate shrinks toward the CORPUS mean over the same window and mode, and is withheld below 30 decided observations (insufficient_sample: true).
Shrinkage moderates extremes but does not adjust for skill or guarantee rank order; no confidence intervals.

Read from the season rollup: counters through 2026-09-24T00:47:43.687Z, distinct players as of 2026-09-24T00:47:43.687Z (a deck or card first seen since then carries players: null until tonight's rebuild).
Forms are separate rows: form is the card FORM played (base, evolution or hero), never a level, so a card played in two forms carries two records.
Card win rates are heavily skill-confounded: compare shrunk rates within similar usage, never across segments.
